title: Russian snow alien body found in Siberia

tellings.quote: Just 1 month later, in that same region of Siberia, two Russian guys come upon an alien body in the woods.
There was a a being found in the snow in Siberia. And it was right after actually a UFO appeared in Kutsk.
tellings.difference: No year is given. The host credits Marshall rather than the two men who found it.
tellings.link_reason: Both tell of the alien body found in the snow in the Irkutsk region of Siberia soon after a UFO appeared there.

as_told.title: Siberian snow alien found after a UFO crash

plain: In 2011, Michels says, two Russian men named Timur and Kirill came across an alien body in the snowy woods of Siberia, one month after a UFO was seen over the same region around the city of Irkutsk. Michels tells it himself on two episodes in 2025. In the later one he gives no year and credits the story to someone he names only as Marshall rather than to the two men who found it. If true, it would be physical remains of a non-human being.
